title: Controlled Electrical Change and Risk
summary: Analyze a simulation-only power change with risk, validation, rollback, and escalation.
objectives: Identify scope, dependencies, reserve, timing, and communication needs for a modeled load change.
Define validation and rollback concepts without performing physical electrical work.

vocab.def: An authorized period in which a planned simulated change is evaluated.
A planned return to the prior known state when validation fails.

sections.heading: Prepare
sections.body: This is analytical simulation only. Learners do not operate switchgear, transfer live loads, modify PDUs, service UPS systems, or perform mains work.

sections.heading: Apply
sections.body: Use request, authorization, affected systems, expected impact, capacity check, simulated implementation, validation, rollback consideration, handoff, and documentation. Include cooling, network, compute, and safety dependencies.

sections.heading: Prove
sections.body: Document the stop conditions and qualified escalation path.

practice.prompt: What should happen before a modeled load addition proceeds?
practice.answer: Authorization, capacity and dependency review, expected-impact planning, and defined validation.

quiz.question: What is rollback?
options: A planned return to a known prior state
A license to change live equipment
quiz.answer: A planned return to a known prior state

lab.objective: Plan a simulated electrical infrastructure change.

reflectionPrompt: What evidence would validate the simulated change?
